item.title: gelliottmorris.com: Democrats won so big in 2026 bc (a) they had high turnout everywhere and (b) the
item.description:
Democrats won so big in 2026 bc (a) they had high turnout everywhere and (b) they won a lot of defectors over from Trump/Rs.
If you apply the same vote-switching rates to 2028, then Dems are favored in the Electoral College and could get 58 Senate seats.
https://www.ms.now/opinion/2026-midterm-results-democrats-2028-election
